items.title: Show HN: Can you spot AI-generated content? (spoiler: probably not)
items.raw_excerpt:
I built this quiz after realizing how good AI has gotten at mimicking literature, speeches, and images. It's one strike and you're out.
It includes AI-generated Shakespeare, fake MLK speeches, photorealistic images, and movie dialogue. I got several of my own questions wrong while building it. This isn't about testing your English degree, it's more about showing how well AI can now forge canonical cultural references. We've hit a point where the fakes are genuinely convincing.
Where AI still slips up:
Over-explanation (real Shakespeare is more economical)
Generic metaphors vs. specific imagery
Too polished (humans are messier) But these tells are fading fast!
Built with React, ~50 questions (for now). The images are tough if you haven't already seen them before.
Curious what scores people

items.title: Show HN: AWAS – An open standard for AI-readable web actions
items.raw_excerpt: I am looking for contributors for an open-source spec called AWAS that lets AI browsers and agents interact with websites via a clean JSON action manifest. On many websites, it doesn’t even work that well. This is an effort to standardize for AI agent access in a way that can be implemented rapidly and without disrupting user driven browsing. items.title: GAIR 2025 世界模型论坛：走向真实智能的起点
items.raw_excerpt: 12 月 13 日，雷峰网 GAIR 2025 将以「走向真实智能的起点」为题，在深圳南山 · 博林天瑞喜来登酒店举办重磅专题论坛。 这是一场关于智能体未来的深度探讨，也是一场面向青年科学家的开放对话。在模型与智能体高速演化的当下，理解“世界”如何被建模、经验如何被抽象、行动如何被模拟，正在成为所有人工智能研究者共同追问的核心命题。 来自世界模型、智能体、强化学习、多模态理解、评估体系与开源实践领域的青年学者，将在这里共聚一堂，探讨构建“能看、能想、能行动”的下一代智能体所需的原理突破与研究路线。 论坛将聚焦两大关键方向： • 真实世界建模能力的跃迁 • 智能体体系结构的整体演化 在这一时代背景下，讨论世界模型，不再只是讨论模型本身，而是在讨论智能的边界与未来形态。 当机器拥有感知世界的能力，当模拟成为智能体理解现实的中枢，当行动策略能够在虚拟空间中提前“成长”，人类正在迈入一个新的智能文明节点。 世界模型这一正在重塑 AI 基础逻辑的结构，不只是算法框架的堆叠，更是智能如何理解世界、推理世界、预测世界的底层能力。它在重构模型训练方式，也在重新定义智能体行为，它在推动具身智能的发展，也在重塑通往 AGI 的路径。 从环境表示的抽象能力，到跨模态学习的统一结构；从大规模模拟系统的搭建，到智能体行为的策略学习；从开放数据集与开源工具链的构建，到评估体系的科学化推进 —— 每一次研究突破，都是对“智能如何生长”的一次深度回响。 论坛特别邀请到活跃在学术前线、极具创造力与开源精神的青年学者，他们分别是： 王靖博：上海人工智能实验室青年科学家 胡文博：腾讯 ARC Lab 高级研究员 彭思达：浙江大学研究员 戴若犁：诺亦腾首席技术官 王广润：中山大学计算机学院副教授 高飞：浙江大学控制科学与工程学院博士生导师 韩晓光：香港中文大学（深圳）助理教授 修宇亮

excerpt_i18n.en:
On December 13, the GAIR 2025 forum, themed "The Starting Point Toward True Intelligence," will host a major special session at the Sheraton Shenzhen Nanshan Hotel. This is an in-depth exploration of the future of agents and an open dialogue for young scientists. Amid rapid evolution in models and agents, understanding how the "world" is modeled, how experience is abstracted, and how actions are simulated is becoming a core question for all AI researchers. Young scholars from fields such as world models, agents, reinforcement learning, multimodal understanding, evaluation systems, and open-source practices will gather to discuss the breakthroughs and research pathways needed to build the next generation of agents capable of "seeing, thinking, and acting." The forum will focus on two key directions:  
• The leap in real-world modeling capabilities  
• The holistic evolution of agent architectures  
In this context, discussing world models is no longer just about the models themselves but about the boundaries and future forms of intelligence. As machines gain the ability to perceive the world, as simulation becomes central to agents' understanding of reality, and as action strategies can "grow" in virtual spaces, humanity is stepping into a new node of intelligent civilization. World models, a structure reshaping the foundational logic of AI, are not merely stacks of algorithmic frameworks but the underlying capabilities for how intelligence understands, reasons about, and predicts the world. They are redefining model training methods and redefining how agents act.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 13 de diciembre, GAIR 2025 de Leifeng Wang celebrará un destacado foro temático en el Sheraton Shenzhen Nanshan Hotel, bajo el título "El punto de partida hacia la inteligencia real". Este evento constituye un profundo debate sobre el futuro de los agentes inteligentes y un diálogo abierto dirigido a jóvenes científicos. En el contexto actual de rápida evolución de modelos y agentes inteligentes, comprender cómo se modela el "mundo", cómo se abstrae la experiencia y cómo se simulan las acciones se está convirtiendo en una cuestión central que todos los investigadores de inteligencia artificial buscan responder. Jóvenes académicos especializados en modelos mundiales, agentes inteligentes, aprendizaje por refuerzo, comprensión multimodal, sistemas de evaluación y prácticas de código abierto se reunirán aquí para intercambiar perspectivas.
